question: text.over_250_words
Does the post explicitly mention an emotion felt by the author or their team?
Does the post explicitly express pride or a sense of accomplishment about the author's or their team's work?
Does the post narrate a sequence of events or tell a story, rather than only making a statement or claim?
Does the post include a direct quotation attributed to a named person or source, set off by quotation marks or explicit attribution?
Does the post include a made-up scenario or example, not tied to a real, named entity, to illustrate a point?
text.under_80_words
Does the post give a concrete scenario, case, or instance (real or hypothetical) to illustrate a point?
Does the post describe an event, drive, or activity that has already finished?
Does the post offer guidance, tips, or recommended actions for the reader?
Does the post state that the author, their team, or organization has achieved something concrete, such as an award, funding, certification, or milestone?
Does the post describe a specific personal experience, activity, or observation from the author's own life or work?
Does the post explicitly state a lesson or takeaway the author learned from personal experience?
Does the post narrate a story about a specific individual's experience or journey?
text.has_link
Does the post mention at least one specific company, organization, or institution by proper name?
Does the author say they are excited or looking forward to something coming next?
Does the post present a list of at least three items?
Does the post report a numeric result the author or their team achieved?
Does the post express gratitude to a specific person or named group?
Does the post narrate a story about a specific client, customer, or founder?
Does the post summarize or report on content from an external source, such as an article, report, or playbook?
Does the post illustrate its point with a hypothetical situation or imagined future scenario?
Does the post include a URL or hyperlink to an external website?
Does the post mention a specific job title or professional role, such as 'engineer', 'product manager', or 'founder'?
text.first_line_has_number
Does the post use first-person plural pronouns (we, our, us) to refer to a group the author belongs to?
Does the post state how long the author has spent on something, such as years in a field or months on a project?
Does the post include at least one specific numeric value, such as a count, percentage, ratio, metric, or measurement, excluding calendar dates?
Does the post frame the content from the first-person perspective of a specific professional role the author holds?
Does the post state that the author is participating in a specific event, program, or appearance, such as as a speaker, judge, or guest?
Does the post advocate for a specific method, practice, or technology?
Does the post contain at least one emoji character?
Does the post explicitly thank or express appreciation to a person, group, or organization?
Does the post state the author's professional background, experience, or credentials beyond a current job title?
Does the post describe something the author learned from a specific person?
Does the author make a joke at their own expense?
Does the post direct the reader to an external resource such as a guide, podcast, article, or product page?
Does the post explicitly express support, respect, or empathy for a specific group of people?
Does the post contain at least one emoji in the main text, excluding any hashtags at the end?
Does the post mention working with another named person or company?
text.has_emoji
Does the post mention a specific geographic location, such as a city, state, country, region, landmark, or venue?
Does the post mention a specific professional role or job function by name?
Does the post mention the author's life outside work, such as family, health, or hobbies?
Does the author credit specific other people for helping them reach an achievement of their own?
Does the post reference a specific event, such as a conference, summit, webinar, meetup, or industry event, by name or clear description?
Does the post publicly acknowledge, credit, or give a shout-out to a specific person, group, or organization?
Does the post describe something happening to the author today or right now?
Does the post explicitly express a personal opinion or belief using first-person language?
Does the post ask the reader a direct question?
Does the post describe the author's attendance, speaking, or involvement in a specific event, program, or initiative?
Does the post mention a non-human animal, either literally or as a prominent image?
text.first_line_is_question
Does the post express gratitude, sympathy, or well-wishes to a person or group?
Does the post present a step-by-step process, method, or framework with ordered steps?
Does the post explicitly contrast or compare two or more things, such as options, ideas, categories, or methods?
Does the post give advice without tying it to anything the author experienced or did?
Does the post mention a company, product, project, or written work that the author created, is involved with, or owns?
Does the post use first-person singular pronouns such as 'I', 'me', or 'my'?
Does the post first describe a problem and then present a solution or fix?
Does the post mention or tag at least two specific individuals by name, either in the body text or in a list of tags?
Does the post compare a previous state with a current or future state, using time references?
Does the post mention at least one specific individual by name?
Does the post name three or more specific people?
Does the first sentence of the post mention a specific named company, product, or person as its main subject?
Does the first sentence place the reader in a specific moment, giving a time, place, or action that happened?
text.single_block
Does the first sentence state a firm opinion or claim on its own line?
Does the post use a metaphor or analogy to explain or illustrate an idea?
Does the post open with a sentence or pair of sentences that presents a direct contradiction or tension between two concepts, without immediately resolving it?
